decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet still has its own page, costs little to carry in a broad collection, and its value remains uncertain, so keeping the option open is cheap, though the sister carpet C was already dropped.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium, low-inventory piece that is still presented on its own page, so its option value stays above its small carrying cost.
The corner bench moved from its own page to a mere mention, which is a weakening signal, but it was promoted as a new interpretation and still offers uncertain project potential at low cost.
The low-pile carpet remains on its own page and close to the established offer, so carrying it costs little while its demand is still being learned.
The swivel shell chair line has several models and steady presentation, giving broad upside for residential and contract markets that justifies keeping it.
